summary: Validated catalog migration end-to-end on real mdlp DB (23,303 meds). Backend pytest: 20/21 pass (1 real bug: pagination overlap on text-score search). Frontend: home, search (/msk/poisk?q=нурофен → 12 cards), med detail (/msk/preparaty/nurofen-200-mg-tabletki-pokrytye-obolochkoy with ЖНВЛП badge, 90.07₽, manufacturer, MNN, Yandex map with 12 prices, variants table, 8 analogs, voice launcher) all render correctly. Backward-compat /preparaty and /poisk do not 404. SEO endpoints (robots, sitemap index, sitemap_meds_1, render home/med/pharmacy) return valid HTML/XML with schema.org. Voice chat + TTS smoke pass.

minor.issue: When sort is by MongoDB textScore, ties are not broken by a stable secondary key, so skip+limit pagination yields overlapping items between page 1 and page 2 (test_search_paracetamol_pagination FAILED). Fix: append a stable secondary sort, e.g. sort=[('score', {'$meta':'textScore'}), ('slug', 1)] or ('_id', 1).

action_items: Fix /api/search pagination stability for text-score queries: add a deterministic secondary sort key (e.g., slug or _id) so page 1 and page 2 don't overlap when many docs share the same textScore.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/search uses MongoDB textScore sort without a stable tiebreaker → unstable pagination (confirmed via test).

api/__init__.py: when q is provided but len < 2, the term is silently ignored (no $text filter) — consider returning a 400 or falling back to regex search so users get feedback instead of an unfiltered list of all 23k meds.

api/seo.py sitemap_meds_{idx}.xml emits 50,000 URLs * 2 cities = 100,000 <url> entries per sitemap, which exceeds the 50k limit per Sitemap protocol. Either chunk by 25,000 medications (so 2 cities * 25k = 50k urls) or split per city.
/api/seo/render returns 200 even for /msk/preparaty/<unknown-slug> wrapped in render_med_for_bot which returns 404; verified working. Good.
/api/medications/{slug}/analogs has no ordering — could return inconsistent analogs across calls; consider .sort('name', 1) for determinism.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing imported mdlp data (23,303 meds, 72,054 SKUs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_catalog_api.py covers all catalog + SEO + voice smoke flows. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_catalog_api.py -v. The only failure (test_search_paracetamol_pagination) requires a backend fix (stable tiebreaker on textScore sort). Frontend home title, /msk/poisk?q= flow, med-detail page with ЖНВЛП/government price/map/variants/analogs, and backward-compat /preparaty + /poisk verified visually.
rca of the issue: Pagination overlap RCA: api/__init__.py line 117 sets sort = [('score', {'$meta': 'textScore'})]. When many medications match the search term with identical text scores (very common for prefix matches like 'парацетамол' across 100+ variants), MongoDB does not guarantee stable order across separate skip/limit queries, so page=1 and page=2 can return overlapping documents. Mitigation: change to sort = [('score', {'$meta': 'textScore'}), ('slug', 1)] so ties break on slug deterministically.
